protocol.source: Binance public daily BTCUSDT one-second spot klines
protocol.model: Existing fixed market-logit correction, training-only scaling, L2 .1, bounds +/-.25; no parameter search
protocol.evaluation: Same development contracts, chronology, fees, 1% risk, .04 edge and .02 slippage
protocol.limits: Event timestamps plus assumed publication allowance, not measured receipt times; trades aggregated into bars, not order-book depth; no holdout/deployment
